name: task_queue
summary: Asyncio-driven 4-pool dispatcher. GPU (VRAM-bounded), Ollama (5 concurrent), Cloud (rate-limited per provider), Deterministic (unbounded, fills gaps). Cache short-circuits dispatch. Crystal-chain log per job. The runtime layer beneath workflow_generator + chat.py + forward_projector.
engine_pattern: asyncio.Semaphore (ollama) + token-bucket _RateLimiter (cloud) + gpu_scheduler (vram) + asyncio.Queue (deterministic). Gap-fill loop drains deterministic queue whenever LLM utilization < 0.8.

pools.GPU: VRAM-aware via gpu_scheduler — both 3090 Ti devices
pools.CLOUD: Token-bucket per provider — claude=30/min, openai=60/min, gemini=60/min defaults
pools.DETERMINISTIC: Unbounded asyncio.Queue — drains when LLM utilization < CC_GAP_FILL_THRESHOLD (default 0.8)

env_vars.CC_GAP_FILL_THRESHOLD: LLM utilization below which deterministic queue drains (default 0.8)

inbound_callers: core/lib/chat.py::cmd_full (every chat turn that needs LLM compute)
outbound_calls: HTTP via task.params['fn'] (caller-provided async fn — keeps queue cloud-provider agnostic)

gap_fill_principle: When ollama_inflight / ollama_pool_size < 0.8, drain one DETERMINISTIC task per 200ms tick. Keeps the system saturated: scans, hashes, file walks, ngram indexing, JSONL parses all happen during LLM gaps. Setup IS asset generation.
guarantees: Same input crystal + same model + same params → cache hit, no compute
Ollama never exceeds CC_OLLAMA_POOL concurrent subprocesses
GPU never overcommitted on VRAM (reservations track in-memory; verify via nvidia-smi)
Deterministic tasks never block LLM dispatch — they only run during gaps
Errors never propagate out of submit() — caught + returned as TaskResult.error
usage_example:
from task_queue import TaskQueue, Task, TaskKind
q = TaskQueue()
await q.start()
r = await q.submit(Task(kind=TaskKind.OLLAMA, agent='qwen2.5-coder:1.5b', prompt='hi'))
print(r.source, r.latency_ms)
